title: A Birthday Invitation
text:
Lisa wants to have a birthday party. She writes invitations for her friends. The party is on Sunday at three o'clock. Please come to my house!

Her friend Ali reads the invitation and smiles. He says yes, he can come. Lisa is happy because many friends will come to the party. They will eat cake and play games.

options: He says he is too tired.
He says he will call later.
He says no, he has a test.
He says yes, he can come.

questions.text: How does Lisa probably feel about her party?

options: She wants to sell her house.
She wants to learn to write.
She wants her friends to come to her party.
She wants to go to school.

vocabulary.definition: cards or messages that ask someone to come to an event
a social event where people eat, talk and have fun

paragraph_translations: Lisa bir doğum günü partisi düzenlemek istiyor. Arkadaşları için davetiyeler yazıyor. Parti pazar günü saat üçte. Lütfen evime gel!
Arkadaşı Ali davetiyeyi okuyor ve gülümsüyor. Evet diyor, gelebilir. Lisa mutlu çünkü partiye birçok arkadaşı gelecek. Pasta yiyecekler ve oyun oynayacaklar.
